scope: 47 standard Mega Stone native theft checks; plot/CAP/unrelated work excluded
evidence_kind: Fresh offline engine matrix plus isolated production-command/model PostgreSQL, captured transport
native_rule: Only the compatible holder's original native species/family protects its stone; the thief's identity does not
reference_holder_dispatch: Pinned Showdown sim/pokemon.ts takeItem passes its holder as the TakeItem event target; the item hook calls that argument source

preliminary_diagnosis.label: reproduction
preliminary_diagnosis.meaning: Fresh pre-fix offline reproduction; failures/control outcomes retained

preliminary_diagnosis.label: focused-native
preliminary_diagnosis.meaning: Both were legitimate Knock Off KOs in frail fixtures; corrected legal Bold/IV/EV defensive setup using real stat helpers, without changing attack power

preliminary_diagnosis.label: sql-player-first
preliminary_diagnosis.meaning: Occupied-thief fixture expected an empty source item despite deliberately equipping Shed Shell; corrected the fixture and conservation check

preliminary_diagnosis.label: sql-mega-core
preliminary_diagnosis.meaning: Old deliberate egg mutation correctly invoked #918 protected end; teardown now asserts retained quarantine/checkpoint and defers final cleanup to its disposable schema

preliminary_diagnosis.label: mandatory-superseded-for-fixture
preliminary_diagnosis.meaning: Superseded test process stopped before acceptance after durable Mega fixture teardown changed; only the complete final three-order gate qualifies

preliminary_diagnosis.label: mandatory-legacy-name-fixture
preliminary_diagnosis.meaning: One old callback wiring test set only a display name to obtain protection. Replaced it with real native Abomasnow and foreign-nickname controls; production code unchanged

limits: No Telnet/WebSocket login or running Evennia acceptance
No game deployment, current world stock or public native-species/move acquisition proof
Direct model-table SQL, not migration-installed integrity triggers
Native moves/nicknames/stock were separately labelled fixture setup
Complete 47-stone engine matrix; persistent command walkthroughs use bounded Blastoisinite/Sablenite representatives
Generic Knock Off item-presence power policy is unchanged; this issue qualifies physical removal protection, not a full move damage audit
Other item backlog repairs, CAP callbacks and plot-only items remain outside this change
